title: Swap Faces on Live Calls. Change Voices. Create Magic.
shortDescription: Set up real-time face swapping and voice changing for live calls, streams and content, step by step on your own computer.
summary30s: A hands-on video course that takes you from zero to running a real-time AI face swap and voice changer on live video calls and streams. You install the tools, tune them for a natural look and sound, and learn where to use them responsibly.
overview: This is the flagship course of AI Fountain Academy. You'll watch every step on screen: choosing the right tools for your computer, installing them, loading a face model, routing the output into Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp desktop, OBS and live streams, and changing your voice in real time. We cover lighting, camera angles and settings that make the result look and sound natural, plus how to fix the common glitches. The course closes with clear rules for responsible use: consent, disclosure and the platform policies you need to respect.
objectives: Install and configure a real-time face swap tool on Windows or Mac.
Route the swapped camera feed into Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp desktop and OBS.
Change your voice live with an AI voice changer and a virtual audio cable.
Tune lighting, angles and settings so the swap looks natural.
Fix lag, flicker and audio delay on everyday hardware.
Use face and voice tools responsibly, with consent and disclosure.
contents: What real-time face swap is and what you need
Loading and preparing a face model
Using the swap on Zoom, Meet and WhatsApp
Making it look and sound natural

title: AI Faceless Product Blueprint
shortDescription: Create, package and sell digital products with AI, without ever showing your face.
summary30s: Learn how to pick a profitable digital product idea, build it quickly with AI tools, and sell it under a faceless brand using simple pages, payments and content.
overview: A practical blueprint for building a digital product business behind a brand instead of your face. You'll validate an idea, use AI to write and design the product (ebooks, templates, prompt packs, mini-courses), set up a sales page and payments, and create faceless content that brings buyers in.
objectives: Find and validate a digital product idea people will pay for.
Use AI to write, design and package the product.
Build a faceless brand identity with AI visuals.
Set up a simple sales page and payment link.
Create faceless promo content that drives sales.

title: AI Faceless YouTube Business
shortDescription: Build a YouTube channel with AI scripts, voiceovers and visuals, no camera or face required.
summary30s: Plan, script, voice and edit faceless YouTube videos with AI, then optimise them for search and grow a channel you can run from your laptop.
overview: Follow along as we build a faceless YouTube channel from niche research to published videos. You'll use AI for scripting, natural voiceovers, stock and generated visuals, editing and thumbnails, then learn titles, descriptions and SEO that help videos get found, and the requirements for monetisation.
objectives: Choose a faceless niche with demand and low competition.
Write engaging video scripts with AI.
Generate natural AI voiceovers and narration.
Assemble and edit videos with AI visuals.
Optimise titles, thumbnails and descriptions for search.
Read YouTube analytics and improve each upload.

title: AI for Business and Marketing
shortDescription: Create ad videos, build product funnels and automate the repetitive parts of selling with AI.
summary30s: Use AI to produce scroll-stopping ad videos, write and build a product funnel, and automate follow-ups so your business keeps selling while you focus on the work.
overview: A marketing toolkit for business owners. You'll create ad videos and creatives with AI, write offers and landing pages, put together a simple product funnel, and connect automations for lead capture, email or WhatsApp follow-ups and order handling.
objectives: Produce ad videos and image creatives with AI tools.
Write offers, hooks and ad copy that convert.
Build a simple product funnel from ad to checkout.
Automate lead capture and follow-up messages.
Measure results and improve your ads.
contents: Where AI fits in your marketing

title: AI Trading for Beginners
shortDescription: Learn trading fundamentals and how to use AI tools for research, analysis and discipline.
summary30s: A beginner-friendly start to trading: how markets and charts work, how AI tools can help you research and analyse, and how to manage risk so one bad trade doesn't hurt you.
overview: This course explains the basics before the tools. You'll learn how markets, orders and charts work, then use AI assistants to summarise news, analyse charts, build a trading plan and keep a journal. Risk management runs through every lesson. Trading carries real risk of loss; nothing in this course is financial advice or a promise of profit.
objectives: Explain how markets, orders and charts work.
Use AI assistants to research and summarise market news.
Read basic chart patterns with AI support.
Write a simple trading plan with clear rules.
Apply position sizing and stop-losses to manage risk.

title: AI SaaS Business Blueprint
shortDescription: Turn AI software into a subscription business: idea, build, pricing and your first customers.
summary30s: Go from an AI app idea to a working product people subscribe to, using no-code and AI coding tools, sensible pricing and simple launch tactics.
overview: This blueprint shows how small teams and solo founders build AI-powered software products. You'll pick a problem worth solving, prototype it with no-code and AI coding tools, connect AI APIs, add accounts and subscription payments, set pricing, and launch to your first users.
objectives: Pick a narrow problem an AI product can solve well.
Prototype the product with no-code and AI coding tools.
Connect AI APIs and manage their costs.
Add accounts and subscription payments.
Price, launch and win your first customers.
